description: The bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT's question-answering performance and ground-truth answers compared to generated answers, across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the correlation, ranging from 0 to 0.7, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each category has four bars representing different comparisons: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (diagonal orange), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (diagonal blue). In the Movies category, Pop_GT shows a correlation of approximately 0.2, Pop_Ge around 0.3, RPop_GT near 0.6, and RPop_Ge close to 0.7. In the Songs category, Pop_GT has a correlation of about 0.1, Pop_Ge around 0.2, RPop_GT near 0.5, and RPop_Ge approximately 0.6. For Basketball, Pop_GT shows a correlation of roughly 0.1, Pop_Ge around 0.2, RPop_GT near 0.4, and RPop_Ge close to 0.3. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
